scope: The standing Library of Parliament conservation exterior at the north end of Centre Block, including its distinct 16-sided rotunda and the short mapped entrance extension.

references.artist: Canadian Illustrated News (illustration unsigned on the printed page)

originalReview.notes: Original print on the cover confirms the stone base, tiers, pointed tracery, radiating Gothic buttresses, roof lantern and pinnacle. The masthead prints the issue date.

quallaSearch.notes: The Qualla photo’s authorship remains assumed. The exact Canadiana scan of the public-domain 1877 printed engraving supplies the historic masonry evidence.

excludedHistoricalImagery.reason: Modern Qualla photograph has assumed rather than identified authorship.
